story: BNT162b2 Vaccine Booster and Mortality Due to Covid-19
text: Vaccines are different from antibiotics in that they are designed to use your own immune system. Whereas an antibiotic targets a bacterial weakness which the bacteria can fix, the immune system watches for both specific invaders and possible variations of those invaders .
